learning_outcomes.text: Acquiring knowledge on optical fibre transmission
To know the main optical components: transmitters, receivers and amplifiers
To learn basic notions on the planning of point-to-point optical communications systems: single-channel and multi-channel (wavelength division multiplexing)

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Optical Fibre Telecommunication Systems (OFTS)
assessment_rules: For assessment throughout the semester, the final mark is 0.35 * laboratory component + 0.325 * first test + 0.325 * second test. A minimum of 7.5/20 is required for each test, and the sum of test marks must be at least 19 to pass. The minimum mark for the laboratory component is 9.5/20. For exam evaluation, a minimum of 9.5/20 is required on the final exam to pass.
